headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.20
summary: The Xbox friends screen no longer shows the same person twice: people you sent a request to stop posing as incoming requests.

items.text: Friend requests now list cleanly. Sending a request no longer makes the other person appear in the incoming list as if they had sent you one, so every pending request shows up once, in the right section, with the right action.
